decisions.title: Local-first LLM via Ollama
decisions.rationale: Privacy + zero API cost. Cloud fallback via AI_POLICY.

decisions.title: pgvector for embeddings
decisions.rationale: Avoid separate vector DB. PostgreSQL handles OLTP + vector search.

decisions.title: LangChain ReAct agent
decisions.rationale: Tool-use pattern fits real estate Q&A. Reasoning trace is auditable.

decisions.title: WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)
decisions.rationale: Primary channel for Argentine market. No third-party BSP cost.

decisions.title: XGBoost for lead scoring
decisions.rationale: Tabular data, interpretable via SHAP, fast inference, no GPU required.

decisions.title: Celery + Redis for task queue
decisions.rationale: Replaced by Supabase Edge Functions in Fase 8.

decisions.title: Next.js 14 standalone Docker output
decisions.rationale: Replaced by Netlify deploy in Fase 8.

decisions.title: Meta-learning feedback loop
decisions.rationale: Continuous improvement of agent, matching, ML scoring from real interactions.

decisions.title: Supabase as primary DB
decisions.rationale: Cloud PostgreSQL + pgvector + RLS. Admin can snapshot locally.

decisions.title: Multi-tenant via agent_id scoping + RLS
decisions.rationale: Single DB. Privacy enforced at Supabase RLS layer.

decisions.title: Property catalog public; owner contacts private
decisions.rationale: Owner contact visible only to listing agent. conversation_summary visible to all.

decisions.title: Cross-agent match: share client name + explanation only
decisions.rationale: Listing agent sees buyer name + reason. No other buyer data exposed.

decisions.title: WhatsApp numbers managed by admin
decisions.rationale: Admin controls onboarding. Each agent gets one phone_number_id.

decisions.title: Supabase Edge Functions replace Celery workers
decisions.rationale: Serverless Deno functions handle async matching + notifications. No Redis, no self-hosted workers.

decisions.title: Netlify for dashboard hosting
decisions.rationale: Next.js 14 on Netlify via @netlify/plugin-nextjs. Already paid plan. No Docker for frontend.

decisions.title: Archive legacy FastAPI backend + Docker Compose stack (TD-006)
decisions.rationale: FastAPI/Celery/old-gateway/docker-compose superseded by Supabase-native arch (D009/D014/D015) and consumed by no production service. Removed from working tree, preserved under git tag 'legacy-fastapi-backend'. Conversational ReAct agent (D003), RAG, lead scoring and scrapers remain only in the archived tag — re-implementation in Edge Functions is a future node if/when needed.
